question: Amazon picked the name Alexa partly because of one letter whose hard sound is rare in everyday speech and easy for a machine to pick out. Which letter?
topic: Smart speakers and voice assistant wake words
source_excerpt: has a hard consonant, the X, which helps it be recognized with higher precision

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a product name is pure branding or someone's favourite name. The real reason is engineering: one sharp, rare sound makes the speaker less likely to wake up during normal talk.
extra.verification_notes: Wikipedia confirms Amazon chose the name Alexa partly for its hard X consonant, which aids recognition (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Alexa).

explanation: The crisp 'ks' sound of the X stands out from normal chatter, so the speaker is less likely to wake up by mistake. The name is also a nod to the ancient Library of Alexandria.

question: Microsoft's voice assistant Cortana took its name from a fictional artificial intelligence in which hit video game series?
topic: Smart speakers and voice assistant wake words
source_excerpt: The virtual assistant takes its name from the AI character in the Halo franchise... Both the assistant and the Halo character share the voice of actress Jen Taylor.

extra.why_interesting: Most people think of Cortana as a dry office assistant built into Windows. Few realize it was named after a fictional AI sidekick from a blockbuster shooter game, voiced by the same actress.
extra.verification_notes: Cortana is named after the AI character in the Halo franchise (shared voice actress Jen Taylor); Cortana's later discontinuation doesn't change the naming fact (https://www.guru3d.com/news-story/microsoft-discontinues-cortanathe-virtual-assistant-for-windows.html).

explanation: In Halo, Cortana is the AI companion who guides the hero, Master Chief. In the US, Microsoft even hired the same actress, Jen Taylor, to voice the real assistant.
